title: Warm and cool colours and the moods they make
examples: Why do blue rooms feel calm?

explain.say: Artists sort colours into 2 groups. One group is warm colours. The other group is cool colours. Look at the board. It shows the 2 groups.

draw.text: Warm and cool colours and the moods they make

explain.say: Look at the warm group. Red, orange and yellow are warm colours. They are the colours of fire and the sun. Warm colours can feel lively and cosy. Can you think of a red, orange or yellow food?
Now look at the cool group. Blue, green and violet are cool colours. They are the colours of the sea, grass and ice. Cool colours can feel calm and quiet. Which group would you choose for a bedroom?

Look at this colour meter. It goes from blue to red. Blue can feel calm. Red can feel strong and bold. Colours mean different things in different places. In China and India, red is a colour for weddings and good luck.

zones.label: Fresh green
zones.note: Gentle and fresh, like spring leaves

zones.label: Fiery red
zones.ask: What does the colour red mean?

explain.say: Warm colours seem to come closer to you. Cool colours seem to move further away. Painters often use blue-grey for faraway mountains. Try this. Draw a picture twice, once in warm colours and once in cool colours. See how the feeling changes.

faq.a: Warm colours are red, orange and yellow, the colours of fire and sunshine. They often feel energetic, cosy or exciting.
asks: Why are red and orange called warm?

faq.a: Cool colours are blue, green and violet, the colours of water, plants and ice. They often feel calm, peaceful and fresh.
asks: Why is blue a cool colour?

faq.a: Green is usually counted as cool, but a yellow-green leans warm and a blue-green leans cool. Every colour can be a warmer or cooler version of itself.
asks: Can a colour be both warm and cool?

faq.q: What does the colour red mean?
faq.a: It depends on where you are. Red can mean danger or stop, love, or energy. In China red stands for luck and happiness, and in India many brides wear red.
asks: Why do brides wear red in India?
Do colours mean the same everywhere?

faq.q: How do artists use warm and cool colours?
faq.a: They use warm colours to grab attention or show heat and excitement, and cool colours for calm, cold or distance. Warm colours seem to come forward and cool ones to move back.

facts: Red, orange and yellow are called warm colours; blue, green and violet are called cool colours.
In Chinese culture red is traditionally the colour of good luck and celebration.

quiz.say: Look at the 3 colours. Which one is a cool colour?
quiz.why: Blue is the colour of water and ice. Blue is a cool colour.

wrong.1: Orange is a warm colour, the colour of fire.
wrong.2: Red is a warm colour, the colour of flames.

quiz.say: You make a poster. You want it to feel lively. Which colours do you use most?
quiz.why: Red, orange and yellow feel lively. People notice them quickly.

wrong.1: Cool colours often feel calm and quiet.
wrong.2: Grey and white often feel quiet. Warm colours feel more lively.
